deployments.itemDescription: Disciplined working-commit assistant. Groups changes into logical changesets, adds CHANGELOG entries under [Unreleased], drafts Conventional Commits messages, and commits only after explicit user approval. Never bumps VERSION, never tags — cutting a release is /release.
